history: Popularized at the Bushwick Country Club in Brooklyn around 2006, though bar-and-brine chasers are much older.
whyItWorks: The brine’s salt and vinegar cancel the whiskey’s burn almost completely. The second shot is the whole mechanism.
steps: Pour the whiskey into one shot glass and the brine into another.
Drink the whiskey, then the brine immediately after.
techniqueNotes: Dill brine, not sweet. Straight from the jar, cold.
name: Pickleback
description: A shot of Irish whiskey, chased by a shot of pickle brine.
